title: Observability: request-by-id lookup, error-body capture and download, runtime debug toggle, usage queue, latest-version check

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

body:
Part of #720 (sub-issue). Case study: [docs/case-studies/issue-720](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-720-99e7abc4e6c1/docs/case-studies/issue-720/README.md).

Blocked by: #718 #719 (declared with GitHub issue dependencies).

## Summary
Operators cannot fetch a logged request by id, capture upstream error bodies for later download, or toggle debug logging without a restart. CLIProxyAPI exposes `/observability/logs`, `/logs/errors[/:name]`, `/logs/requests/:id`, `/observability/usage/{api-keys,queue}` and `/server/latest-version`. Router has `requests.lino` with size caps, `AUDIT_LOG`, `/metrics` and `/usage`.

Blocked by #718 (persist server logs by default) and #719 (local error responses logged), which define the file-logging baseline this builds on.

Case study: `docs/case-studies/issue-720/solution-plans.md` § H.

## Proposal
1. `GET /api/management/logs/requests/{id}` served from `requests.lino` (links notation), admin-scoped.
2. Opt-in error-body capture (`ERROR_LOG_DIR`, `ERROR_LOG_MAX_BYTES`) with `GET /api/management/logs/errors[/{name}]` and `DELETE /api/management/logs`.
3. `PATCH /api/management/logging` to toggle debug level at runtime, audit-logged, auto-reverting after `LOG_DEBUG_TTL_SECS`.
4. `GET /api/management/usage/queue` (in-flight and queued requests per account) and `GET /api/management/server/latest-version` reusing `doctor` logic.

## Tests
Request-by-id round trip; size cap evicts oldest; debug toggle reverts; endpoints require admin scope; error capture off by default.

## Prior art
CLIProxyAPI `internal/logging/*_test.go`, management API v8 observability section; Router `docs/use-cases/audit-and-monitoring.md`.

## Security
Error bodies may contain prompts; capture is off by default, admin-only, and excluded from public metrics.
